caption_review.method: Viewed downloaded contact sheet of opening, long, middle and closing cues, plus live browser playback
findings: White Archivo heading text on solid graphite highlight remains left aligned and visibly off center.
Sampled lines fit without clipping and stay clear of face and eyes.
49 cues and all 184 script words are preserved.
Fresh R5 audio offset matches R4, so retained SRT is byte-identical.
Decoded final captioned soundtrack exactly matches raw Sync output; no timing drift added by caption burn.

limits: Sampled visual checks and browser playback do not constitute owner naturalness acceptance or a perceptual audiovisual-sync verdict.
No publication, canonical avatar promotion or editorial approval performed.

synchronized_facial_review.method: Muted normal-speed browser playback of opening and closing passages, then paused snapshots after seek completion. Approximate player times.
observations: 5s: asymmetric smile, cheek lift and smiling eyes remain; speaking mouth differs from native after restoration
8s: gaze returns to lens and smile relaxes
45s: soft cheek and eye engagement in closing passage
50s: direct attentive gaze in final question without a held grin
53s ending: warm closed-mouth smile and direct gaze
synchronized_facial_review.limits: Sampled observations do not establish a continuous-motion or audible-sync verdict.
